description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller handling login-related web requests such as displaying login page, handling access denied, and unauthorized responses in an admin context.

classes.name: LoginController
classes.description: Controller managing login, logout, and access denial pages in the admin section.

methods.name: displayLogin
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the login page at /admin/logon.html.

methods.name: displayDenied
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /admin/denied.html, logs out the user if authenticated, and redirects to login page.

methods.name: unauthorized
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /admin/unauthorized.html and displays the unauthorized access page.
